sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Test handle vertical range: press DOWN repeatedly, watch position + bar + grid
def snap(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation['nodes']
    h=[]; bar=None; gw=gn=gg=0
    for nd in seg:
        bnd=nd['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bnd); r1=max(p[0] for p in bnd)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in bnd); c1=max(p[1] for p in bnd)
        if 17<=r0<=23 and c0>=36 and nd['color'] in ('b','S') and nd['pixels']<=8:
            h.append((nd['color'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
        if nd['color']=='g' and 17<=r0<=23 and c0<=20 and nd['pixels']>30:
            bar=(r0,r1,c0,c1,nd['pixels'])
        if 48<=r0<=62 and 23<=c0<=37:
            if nd['color']=='W': gw+=nd['pixels']
            if nd['color']=='N': gn+=nd['pixels']
            if nd['color']=='g': gg+=nd['pixels']
    return sorted(h),bar,(gw,gn,gg)
print("start:",snap(current_frame))
for i in range(6):
    action(['DOWN'])
    print(f"DOWN {i+1}:",snap(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

# Test handle vertical range: press DOWN repeatedly, watch position + bar + grid
def snap(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation['nodes']
    h=[]; bar=None; gw=gn=gg=0
    for nd in seg:
        bnd=nd['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bnd); r1=max(p[0] for p in bnd)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in bnd); c1=max(p[1] for p in bnd)
        if 17<=r0<=23 and c0>=36 and nd['color'] in ('b','S') and nd['pixels']<=8:
            h.append((nd['color'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
        if nd['color']=='g' and 17<=r0<=23 and c0<=20 and nd['pixels']>30:
            bar=(r0,r1,c0,c1,nd['pixels'])
        if 48<=r0<=62 and 23<=c0<=37:
            if nd['color']=='W': gw+=nd['pixels']
            if nd['color']=='N': gn+=nd['pixels']
            if nd['color']=='g': gg+=nd['pixels']
    return sorted(h),bar,(gw,gn,gg)
print("start:",snap(current_frame))
